# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch81

Reviewer: strongest model. Dillmann unavailable; lexical calls hedged (?). No modern translation opened. `t` checked
(joined, whitespace aside) against the packet: identical, untouched. All edits made to `units.json` by script (only `l`, `i`, `n`).
Checked against ch. 80 and the glossaries of the published parts (house renderings).

## Changes (unit · field · severity · what was wrong · what was done)

Units are numbered from 0 (0 = the heading).

1. 5 · l, i, n · major · ይትዋነዩ rendered 'served, waited on' (tä-stem of an invented ዋንየ); the published parts (ch. 2–8, ch. 80) gloss ተዋነየ 'sport, play' and ch. 80 has the same boys 'eat and play'. · l 'they-played', i 'the boys played in front of them and ate with them', n rewritten with the house gloss.
2. 8 · l, i, n · major · the last clause read የኀጥ as 'swallows' (ውኅጠ) and i invented 'what he had taken'. የ- is the guttural-initial imperfect (cf. የኀድጋ, የሐውር); ወየኀጥኡ in ch. 35 is the house parse of ኀጥአ 'err, miss', so የኀጥ is ይኀጥእ with the final ʾ unwritten. · l 'without it-misses(?) which(f.) went(?)', i 'fell into the dish without missing (?)'; n states both readings. Still obscure: እንተ ሄደ.
3. 8 · l, n · moderate · አውቀዮ: the suffix -ዮ ('him', after a final -y radical) was ignored; l dropped it. · l 'struck(?)-him(?) his-head'; n explains the double object; root still unidentified (?).
4. 10 · n · moderate · ፈርሃ labelled 3ms with 'loose agreement'; it is the 3fp perfect of ፈርሀ (-ā ending, like ኢነገራ, ወውኅጣ, ተናጸራ). · n corrected.
5. 11 · l, i, n · moderate · አስተጣግዐት: 'lifted it onto her shoulder' contradicted l and n ('neck') and had no basis; no object suffix on the verb. · l 'pressed-close(?)', i 'pressed it close against her neck (?)'; n says the verb is unparsed, ክሳዲ is 'neck' with the unexplained ending as in ክሳዲኒ (ch. 33–34).
6. 14 · l, i, n · moderate · ተሀጐልነ is a 1cp PERFECT, glossed and rendered as a future/subjunctive ('shall we be lost', 'should we be lost'). · 'were-we-lost', 'Why have we been lost, because of the others (?)'; n corrected. እምካልኣኒሆሙ kept hedged (see unresolved).
7. 15 · l, i, n · moderate · ፀዋገ 'lurking/watchful' ignored the house glosses ('wretched, base' ch. 2–8, 76; 'captor' ch. 49–50). The ch. 49 list ('bright and not ፀዋግ') and Cain's look in ch. 2 point to a 'dark, grim' sense, which suits ከመ ድብ. · 'grim (?)' in l, i, n; the n says it is one more guess.
8. 24 · i, n · moderate · ከመ ዘኮነ…: i imported 'like the others'; the n's claim that all rightful kingdoms are Shem's was unsupported. · i 'of the same kind as that which belonged to the seed of Shem (?)'; n parses the two ከመ (complementizer 'that'; 'as that which'), softens the reading, notes Genesis 10:14 (Philistines under Ham).
9. 6 · l, n · moderate · l 'crammed-his-mouth(?)' puts a word into l that is not in ተፍእመ; n also called እድ a 'feminine dual' (no dual in Geʿez; ch. 80 review ruled this out). · l 'stuffed-(his-mouth)(?)'; n: ክልኤሆን is feminine because እድ is a feminine noun.
10. 7 · n · moderate · claimed 'I rely on Dillmann' for ጠለፈ although Dillmann was not open. · rewritten 'lexical call made without Dillmann (?)'; alternative sense of ዘአትረፈ እምአፉሁ added.
11. 9 · l, n · moderate · አንቀጥቀጠ labelled 'ʾa-causative of ተቀጥቀጠ' (it is the quadriliteral አንቀጥቀጠ, አን- + ቀጥቀጠ); እዴሁ ወእገሪሁ called 'dual-type' (singular nouns used collectively); l had plurals. · n corrected, hedged; l 'his-hand and-his-foot'; i keeps 'hands and feet'.
12. 5 · n · minor · ሀለዋ explained by a '-ዋ' ending; it is the 3fp perfect with the -ā ending. · n corrected. Also መጽብኅ marked as a context guess (?).
13. 0 · l · minor · ለወልደ rendered 'the-son-of'; ch. 80 renders the object ለ- as 'to-'. · l 'to-son-of'.
14. 1 · n · minor · spelling of the name described wrongly; the ኢይነግሥ explanation tightened (3ms prefix with 1cs sense, scribal/idiomatic slip (?)). 
15. 4 · i · minor · 'were drunk' for perfect ሰክሩ. · 'got drunk (?)'.

17. 15 · l, n · minor · l 'gave-it' vs the house gloss 'gave him'; ትርኣስ, ወየውሀቶ, ሜላት hedges made fuller (የዋህ 'gentle' as a possible root for ወየውሀቶ; ሜላት 'a dyed stuff, perhaps purple' as in ch. 17–20, 43). · l 'gave-him'; n extended.

## The drafter's flagged words, re-derived

- ኢይነግሥ / ኢይነብር: 3ms imperfect with አነ as subject; 1cs would be ኢእነግሥ. Kept as 1cs sense with (?) in n; i not hedged (sense clear). Unresolved grammar.
- ኢየኀድግ: same pattern (3ms form, 1cs sense, 'I will not leave you', next verb ወእነግሥ is 1cs). Kept (?). The gloss must say 3ms imperfect (guttural የ-).
- ክልኤሆሙ with ሰክሩ: both masculine plural (3mp, m. 'both'), the two boys; the women are ክልኤሆን and ሰከራ would be needed for them. Kept with (?); i fixed to 'got drunk'.
- ተፍእመ: not parsable. Kept hedged; l no longer contains an invented word.
- ጠለፎ: 'snatched it' kept (?) ; Dillmann claim removed.
- ጥብሬሌስ: name, 'Tibreles' kept (?) as drafted.
- አውቀዮ: see 3.
- ዘእንበለ የኀጥ እንተ ሄደ: see 2. Unresolved.
- አስተጣግዐት / ክሳዲ: see 5. Unresolved.
- ኒዒ: ንዒ 2fs imperative, kept (?); glossary lemma ንዓ already in known forms.
- እምካልኣኒሆሙ: እም + ካልእ pl. + -ሆሙ; sense 'because of / from the others of them' guessed (?). Unresolved.
- ትርኣስ: unidentified; 'store' guess (?). Unresolved.
- ሜላት: house hedge (a dyed stuff, perhaps purple) kept; i 'purple (?)' retained for consistency with ch. 17–20, 31–32, 43 (others say 'covering'). 
- ወየውሀቶ: 'soothed him (?)', perhaps from የዋህ; unresolved.
- ፀዋገ: see 7.
- ፈርሃ: see 4 (resolved).
- በጽምሚት: 'in silence/secret (?)'; ጽምሚት unverified, 'in the dark' (ጽልመት) not excluded. Unresolved.
- መሐዛት / መገብት / ተስእልዎ: see 18; ተስእልዎ is 3mp tä-stem + 'him', 'asked about him (?)'.
- Last unit ከመ: see 8.

## Findings refused

- Cutting unit 15 (49 words > ~45): it has no ፤ inside; the convention cuts only at a ፤. Kept; the n already says so.
- Treating ሜላት as other than 'purple (?)': ch. 29/46/55 say 'covering', ch. 17–20/31–32/43 'dyed stuff, perhaps purple'; both hedged, no new evidence, kept the drafter's.
- ወወሀበቶ 'gave it to him' in i: ቶ is 'him/it'; the garment is the understood object. Kept.
- ተዐጽወ (3ms) with plural ኀዋኅው: normal Geʿez agreement; no change.
- ኢይነግሥ i without (?): the English is plain whichever way the person reads the prefix; n carries the hedge.
- Identity Akemehel = Menahem (ch. 80): already hedged '(probably, ?)' in n of unit 1; no source to decide.
- ንጉሠ in unit 7 as construct: correct.

## For the glosser / pass 2

- Known entries needing broadening: ተሐውር (here 2ms, 'you will go'), እማቲሆሙ (here 'their mothers', as in ch. 43; known entry says maidservants), ፀዋገ, ክሳዲ ('neck', ending unexplained), ዘሜላት/ሜላተ, ወየኀጥኡ-type የኀጥ → ኀጥአ, ይትዋነዩ → ተዋነየ 'play', ፈርሃ (3fp), ተሀጐልነ (1cp perfect), ሄደ.
- Novel forms in a published-form clash: ክልኤሆን applies to እደዊሁ (feminine because እድ is feminine; no 'dual').

## Refused / not changed

- ቅድሜሆን → ቅድም: the house glossaries use ቅድሜ.
- ወተፍእመ, ጠለፎ, ጥብሬሌስ, ወመልኀት, ተጸወነ, ምስዋረ, በጽምሚት, ወየውሀቶ, እምትርኣሲሃ, እምካልኣኒሆሙ: remain hedged; no evidence to resolve.
- ኢይነግሥ, ወኢይነብር, ኢየኀድግ: kept as 3ms imperfect with 1cs sense (?), as in pass 1.
- Known ልብሳ is labelled '-ኣ 3fs her'; the 3fs suffix is -ሃ (ልብሳ = ልብስ + -ሃ, after a consonant). A published form; not edited, flagged for the owner.
- Known ኪያኪ, ወይቤላ, ለወልደ, ንጉሠ, ከመ, እምዘ, ፭: all cover this chapter's uses; no broadening.
